description_en: Modifies the auto-renewal configuration of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 修改云数据库RDS实例的自动续费配置
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-instance-auto-renewal-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-bp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceAutoRenewalAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610399.html to query the available regions
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token that is generated by the client. The token is an ASCII string and can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 幂等性令牌，由客户端生成（ASCII字符，最大长度64）
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 12.
This parameter is required when AutoRenew is set to True
parameters.help_zh:
续费周期（单位：月），取值：1~12。
当AutoRenew=True时必须传入此参数
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
True: Enabled.
False: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭自动续费。取值：
True：开启。
False：关闭
parameters.name: auto_renew
